snapshots.note: v1 draft from description: 18-option choice with descriptions; no labels
v2: broadened 'other' (persuader answering/talking about self, confirming donation choice), labelled examples in option criteria; 10/10 on bought labels (examples included)

v3: batch-2 rules (fragments tagged by their turn's strategy, praise must be the point, rhetorical program questions = credibility, other donation channels = donation-info); 20/20 on bought labels (examples in criteria)
v4: batch-3 rules (child vulnerability=emotion, reasons to choose StC / helping everyone matters=logical, reflective concessions=other); 30/30 on bought labels

v5: batch-4 rules (invitations to elaborate/ask = task-inquiry, 'up to you'/what the chat is about = donation-info, specific-sum asks = ask-amount, persuader's own work/answers = other); 40/40 on bought labels

v8 final: 3-member wording-variant ensemble of the v7 scheme (batch-5 rules + self-modeling clarification); 50/50 on bought labels (fit, labels are in examples); estimate is a judgment, no unbiased labels
